cases.description: An expired regular item is blocked without human review.
messages: Hi, I want to return an item.
My order ID is CL1001 and my email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the item is outside the 30-day return window.
Do not say that human review is required.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A regular eligible item receives a return label without human review.
messages: Please start a return for the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that a return label was created.
Provide the generated return-label URL.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not say that human review is required.

cases.description: A customer who says only dress must choose between two matching items.
messages: Hi, I want to return a dress.
My order ID is CL1002 and my email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Ask the customer to choose between the white short dress and the floral short dress.
Do not state whether the return is eligible.
Do not say that human review is required.

cases.description: A final-sale item is blocked without creating a label or escalating.
messages: I want to return the black pants from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the pants cannot be returned because they are final sale.
Explain that damaged or wrong final-sale items are exceptions.
Do not say that human review is required.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: Damaged swimwear enters exception flow without creating a label.
messages: Please return the pink swimsuit from order CL1002; it arrived damaged. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the damaged swimwear requires human review.
Confirm that a support case was created.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A customer disputes a blocked final-sale decision and receives a support case.
messages: I want to return the black pants from order CL1002 because they are too big. My email is maya@example.com.
I disagree with that final-sale decision. Please have a person review it.

response_requirements: Confirm that the final-sale dispute requires human review.
Confirm that a support case was created.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: An angry customer receives support after a trusted blocked evaluation from a return attempt or read-only check.
messages: I want to return the item from order CL1001. My email is maya@example.com.
This is ridiculous. I am still angry and want someone to review this.

response_requirements: Acknowledge that the customer is upset or frustrated.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A repeatedly unverified customer receives a support case without order details being revealed.
messages: I need to return an item from order CL9999. My email is maya@example.com.
I checked and those are the details I have. Please get human support.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.

cases.description: A customer who cannot provide verification information receives human support without exposing order details.
messages: I need to return an item, but I forgot both my order ID and the email I used.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.

cases.description: An eligibility inquiry does not authorize a return write.
messages: Can I return the white short dress from order CL1002? My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the item is eligible for return.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not claim that a return or label was created.

cases.description: Two explicit attempts for the same item return one created label and then the persisted label.
messages: Please start a return for the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.
Please start the same return for the white short dress again. I need its label.

response_requirements: Explain that a return already exists for the white short dress.
Provide the existing return-label URL.
Do not claim a second return or label was created.

cases.description: A customer with an email but no available order ID receives human support without verification.
messages: I need to return an item. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.

cases.description: A customer with an order ID but no available email receives human support without verification.
messages: I need to return an item from order CL1002, but I forgot the email I used and cannot provide it.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.

cases.description: A customer supplies a previously unavailable order ID after escalation and completes a verified return.
messages: I want to return the white short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.
I found it: my order ID is CL1002. Please start the return for the white short dress.

response_requirements: Confirm that a return label was created.
Provide the generated return-label URL.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not say that human review is required.

cases.description: MANUAL-001: Clarify order scope before acting on a later request with an unavailable order ID.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.
My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return the floral short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.

response_requirements: Ask the customer to confirm whether the floral short dress belongs to the already verified order CL1002.
Do not claim that a support case, return, or label was created for this new request.

cases.description: MANUAL-002: An earlier verified order must not block missing-credentials support for a different order.

messages.content: Can I return the white short dress from order CL1002? My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return the floral short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.

response_requirements: Ask the customer to confirm whether the floral short dress belongs to the already verified order CL1002.
Do not claim that a support case, return, or label was created for this new request.

messages.content: This dress is from a different order. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide that order ID.

response_requirements: Confirm that a support case was created for human review and provide its ID.
Do not ask the customer to provide the unavailable order ID as a prerequisite for creating the support case.

cases.description: MANUAL-003: A read-only inquiry after creation must acknowledge the persisted return.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.
Can I return the white short dress from that order?

response_requirements: Explain that a return already exists for the white short dress.
Do not imply that a new return still needs to be started or that a second return was created.

cases.description: MANUAL-004: A renewed request using "it" must receive a fresh approval after rejection.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.
My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that no return or label was created because approval was declined.

messages.content: sorry actually return it

response_requirements: Confirm that the white short dress return and label were created.
Provide the return-label URL.

cases.description: MANUAL-004: Repeating a complete return request after rejection must receive a fresh approval.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.
My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that no return or label was created because approval was declined.

messages.content: Please return the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the white short dress return and label were created.
Provide the return-label URL.

cases.description: MANUAL-005: After rejecting a verified return, verify CL9999 in the switching turn before asking for an item.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return an item from a different order, CL9999. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the order could not be verified and ask the customer to check the order ID and email.
Do not ask which item to return before successful order verification.
Do not reveal or invent contents of CL9999.

cases.description: Control: Explicitly referring to the same verified order does not require recovering its ID.

messages.content: Can I return the white short dress from order CL1002? My email is maya@example.com.
Please return the floral short dress from that same order. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find my order ID.

response_requirements: Confirm that the floral short dress return and label were created.
Do not require the customer to recover the already verified order ID.

cases.description: Control: A polite acknowledgement after rejection is not permission to retry the return.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that no return or label was created because approval was declined.

messages.content: Thanks.

response_requirements: Do not claim that a return or label was created or that a new return request was submitted.

cases.description: A new order cannot borrow the previous order's email; later supplied credentials allow verification.

messages.content: Can I return the white short dress from order CL1002? My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return the floral long dress from a different order, CL1001.

response_requirements: Ask for the checkout email for this order.
Do not claim that CL1001 is verified or disclose its contents.

messages.content: My email for CL1001 is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the item is outside the 30-day return window.
Do not claim that a return or label was created.

cases.description: Verification support for a different unknown order does not prevent later supplied credentials from authorizing its return.

messages.content: Can I return the floral long dress from order CL1001? My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return the floral short dress from a different order. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find that order ID.

response_requirements: Confirm that a support case was created for human review and provide its ID.

messages.content: I found the order ID for that floral short dress: CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the floral short dress return and label were created.

cases.description: Switching between known orders, including returning to the first, requires fresh verification each time.

messages.content: Can I return the white short dress from order CL1002? My email is maya@example.com.
Can I return the floral long dress from a different order, CL1001? My email for CL1001 is maya@example.com.
Back to order CL1002: can I return the white short dress? My email for CL1002 is maya@example.com.

cases.description: A corrected order ID after failed verification preserves the pending return intent and selected product.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL9999. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the order could not be verified and ask the customer to check the order ID and email.
Do not ask which item to return before successful order verification.
Do not claim that a support case, return, or label was created.

messages.content: Sorry, I mistyped the order ID. It is CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the white short dress return and label were created.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.

cases.description: An explicit eligibility-only instruction supersedes a pending return request before credentials complete verification.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.

response_requirements: Ask for the email address associated with order CL1002.
Do not claim that the order is verified or that a return or label was created.

messages.content: Actually, only check whether it is eligible; do not start a return. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the white short dress is eligible for return.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not claim that a return or label was created or that return approval is required.

cases.description: A polite acknowledgement after missing-ID support preserves unresolved return intent for a later credentials-only follow-up.

messages.content: I want to return the floral short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.

response_requirements: Confirm that human support review is required and a support case was created; provide its ID.
Do not require the unavailable order ID as a prerequisite for creating the support case.
Do not claim that a return or label was created.

messages.content: Thanks.

response_requirements: Do not claim that a new support case, return, or label was created.

messages.content: I found it: CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the floral short dress return and label were created.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not say that human review is still required for this return.

cases.description: An explicit cancellation clears pending return intent so a later email-only message cannot restart verification or request approval.

messages.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.

response_requirements: Ask for the email address associated with order CL1002.
Do not claim that the order is verified or that a return or label was created.

messages.content: Actually, cancel that return request. I do not want to return it.

response_requirements: Acknowledge that the return request was cancelled.
Do not claim that a return or label was created or ask for return approval.

messages.content: My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Do not claim that the cancelled return was restarted, submitted, or created.
Do not request return approval or claim that a label or support case was created.

cases.description: An explicit product that does not match a single-item verified order requires clarification; correcting it retains verification and resumes the pending return with fresh approval.

messages.content: Please return the white short dress from order CL1001. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Ask the customer to clarify or confirm the floral long dress as the item to return.
Do not claim that the white short dress belongs to order CL1001.
Do not state return eligibility or request return approval before resolving the product mismatch.
Do not claim that a return, label, or support case was created.

messages.content: I meant the floral long dress.

response_requirements: Explain that the floral long dress is outside the 30-day return window and cannot be returned.
